name: @olano/singapore-mcp-monorepo
description: Open-source MCP servers for Singapore public data and services

scripts.build: npm run build -w @olano/mcp-core && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-datagov && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-onemap && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-lta && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-weather && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-catalog && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-finance-sg && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-analytics && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-insights-sg && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-rail-sg && npm run build -w @olano/mcp-singapore && npm run build -w @olano/sg-cli
scripts.check:plugins: node scripts/check-claude-plugins.mjs && node scripts/check-openai-plugins.mjs && node scripts/build-plugin-server.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && node scripts/check-capability-coverage.mjs && npm run check:plugins
